title: Bounded orbit of a wandering domain
exact_target: Can an entire function have a wandering Fatou component all of whose forward images stay in one bounded region?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300067 (AMR-052-0067). CC BY 4.0.

Ben Bielefeld, Mikhail Lyubich and contributors, \emph{Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics}, arXiv:math/9205209v1 (1992), Alexandre Eremenko and Mikhail Lyubich, ``Wandering Domains for Holomorphic Maps, Question 1.
